subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this PR require retained live Discord proof before merge, or can maintainers accept the existing source-level tests plus unretained canary observation?
rationale: The code path is focused, but the change suppresses channel-visible progress and the only after-fix live evidence is an unretained operator observation.

options.title: Require retained Discord proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing failed progress hidden and fallback warnings still delivered before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: Allow maintainers to merge after branch refresh while explicitly accepting that the live canary evidence was not retained.

recommendation.title: Require retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing failed progress hidden and fallback warnings still delivered before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord progress and shared channel-progress history makes this the strongest routing candidate for proof-sufficiency review.
